story.title: Our story
body: It started in a cafe in Kyoto, with one bagel.
I had always thought a bagel was simply hard. That one bite changed my mind: soft, chewy, and so good.
In Johor Bahru, BHous began in a home kitchen. One person, two hands, baking that surprise again.
We bake only what you order, so every bagel reaches you fresh. We open on set days and close the day before.
We are new, and still learning. Thank you for being one of the first to try us.
body_zh: 故事从京都一家 cafe 里的一个贝果开始。
我一直以为贝果就是硬硬的。那一口，把我的想法改了：柔软、有嚼劲，而且真的很好吃。
在新山，BHous 从一间家庭厨房开始。一个人，一双手，想把那份惊喜再烤出来。
我们只做你订的份量，所以每一个贝果都是新鲜的。我们只在固定的日子开放，前一天中午截止。
我们是新店，还在学习。谢谢你成为最早尝试我们的人。

tagline: Handmade bagels, baked to order. Pre-order and pick up near you.
tagline_zh: 手工贝果，接单现做。预订后，在附近取货。
